observations: Photo 0: Front view of a black Nikon DSLR camera with a lens attached. The camera body has 'Nikon' and 'D90' visible. The lens is labeled 'Nikon AF-P DX NIKKOR 18-55 VR'. The camera appears used, with some dust and wear.

Photo 1: Top view of the camera, showing the screen, control dials, and lens. The lens is clearly labeled 'Nikon AF-P DX NIKKOR 18-55 VR'. The camera body shows signs of use, including scratches and dirt.

Photo 2: Rear view of the camera, showing the LCD screen, viewfinder, and buttons. The screen is off and appears dirty. The camera body has visible wear and scratches. The lens is attached and appears intact.

claims.claim: This is a Used Nikon D90 DSLR Camera With 18-55MM lens
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show the Nikon D90 body and 18-55mm lens. The seller's text matches the visual evidence.
No photo shows the camera powered on or in use. The screen is off in photo 2, and no operation is visible. No proof of functionality is provided.

risks.risk: The camera may not power on or may have functional issues (e.g., shutter, sensor, lens, or electronics)
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the camera powered on, with the screen lit and the menu displayed, and a test shot taken.

risks.risk: The lens may have internal damage or scratches not visible in the photos
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens glass, especially the front and rear elements, under bright light to check for scratches or haze.

risks.risk: The camera may have a damaged or non-functional sensor or mirror
risks.proof: A photo or video showing the camera taking a clear photo with the lens attached, or a close-up of the sensor under the lens.
risks.if_unproven: priced as sensor or mirror damage

proof_requests: Video or photo of the camera powered on, showing the screen lit and menu displayed.
Close-up photo of the lens glass under bright light to check for scratches or haze.
Photo or video of the camera taking a clear photo with the lens attached.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
